messages.text: 'Nowhere else I want to be' - Norris extends McLaren contract until 2030

metadata.summary: Reigning Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris has extended his contract with McLaren until at least 2030.
metadata.content: Lando Norris: McLaren driver signs contract extension until 2030 with target of more world championships | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Breaking Lando Norris: McLaren driver signs contract extension until 2030 with target of more world championships Lando Norris commits long-term future to McLaren; reigning world champion agrees multi-year extension to previous deal; the Brit has already driven in a team record 163 grands prix for McLaren; watch the Italian Grand Prix at Monza live on Sky Sports F1 on September 4-6 Saturday 29 August 2026 10:31, UK Reigning Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris has extended his contract with McLaren until at least 2030. The 26-year-old Brit's previous extension, which was announced ahead of the start of the 2024 season, was understood to tie him to the team until at least the end of 2027. He will now stay at McLaren for at least another four seasons with the extended deal to the end of 2030 including "a multi-year option to commit beyond that date". messages.text: Barcola set to sign Liverpool contract to 2031

metadata.summary: Bradley Barcola is set to sign a Liverpool contract to 2031 after the Premier League club reached an agreement with Paris Saint-Germain over the structure of the transfer.
metadata.content: Bradley Barcola set to sign Liverpool contract to 2031 after PSG agree transfer worth up to £123m | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Bradley Barcola set to sign Liverpool contract to 2031 after PSG agree transfer worth up to £123m Liverpool reached a £120m deal in principle earlier this week to sign PSG forward Bradley Barcola; Reds set to pay £106m up front - and package could reach £123m By Vinny O'Connor Saturday 29 August 2026 10:40, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player What are the four things Liverpool fans should know about transfer target Bradley Barcola? Bradley Barcola is set to sign a Liverpool contract to 2031 after the Premier League club reached an agreement with Paris Saint-Germain over the structure of the transfer. Sky Sports reported on Friday that an agreement in principle had been reached for Barcola to move to Anfield in a package worth £120m. The final discussions had centred over the structure of deal, with Liverpool now set to pay £106m up front and up to £17m in add-ons. Documents must still be exchanged between the clubs and Barcola must complete a medical, which is expected to take place this weekend. The English duo are tied 27th on three-under-par after Woad slipped back from a promising first round through a one-over 73 and Hull posted a two-under 70. messages.text: Greaves denied by Cross in last-leg thriller on European Tour debut

metadata.summary: Beau Greaves took Rob Cross to a last-leg decider before losing out 6-5 on her European Tour debut in the first round of the Hungarian Darts Trophy.
metadata.content: Hungarian Darts Trophy: Beau Greaves just loses out to Rob Cross in last-leg decider on European Tour debut | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to content Hungarian Darts Trophy: Beau Greaves just loses out to Rob Cross in last-leg decider on European Tour debut Beau Greaves became the first woman to play in a PDC European Tour event after qualifying for the Budapest tournament last month; Greaves and Rob Cross both averaged over 100 in first-round match with Cross edging the deciding leg after errors from opponent when left with chance on 70 Saturday 29 August 2026 01:05, UK Image: Rob Cross and Beau Greaves delivered a stunning round-one contest in Hungary (Gabor Kiss/PDC Europe image) Beau Greaves took Rob Cross to a last-leg decider before losing out 6-5 on her European Tour debut in the first round of the Hungarian Darts Trophy. Rising star Greaves, 22, made history by becoming the first woman to compete in a PDC European Tour event after qualifying last month for both this weekend's tournament in Budapest and the Czech Darts Open in September. And she pushed the experienced Cross to a deciding 11th leg in a thrilling tie on Friday evening, averaging an impressive match-best of 104.88 and hitting five 180s.
